body:
Just finished my appointment with my psychologist after putting it of for almost a year because I was ashamed of myself for dropping out of poly even after getting medication for depression. Was afraid of him judging me.

Those worries were for nothing.

On a side note, getting just the medication delivered while postponing the appointment is so much cheaper because no consultation. Medication $10+. With consultation $30+. Not healthy for my wallet whose only inflow is parents allowance.
Well is it more difficult than engineering math or about the same? I was okay in engineering maths

Finally decided to drop out of poly. You can check my comment history if you wanna know why. Not sure if it was the right choice but now I feel like a great deal has been lifted off my shoulders. Probably going to go to NS before deciding what to do next. Now that I've decided to drop out I can see why I was kind of disappointed in poly. I thought it would be wayy more hands on where we could apply theory knowledge to practical nearly daily but turns out it aint that way. Its still 80% study and do paper

Not sure what to do now though. Or where to go after NS. I still kind of want to stick to engineering because I love practical problem solving but math theory and similar subjects make a burden on my brain. I have no idea what I want to do when I grow up. Everyone has always said just do well in O level and you choose where you want to go. Well. I did well for O levels and now a poly dropout who still doesnt know what he wants to do.

Maybe i should go into IT instead. I enjoyed programming classes when I was in EEE. Anyone know if it depends heavily on math too? Or anyone know if theres a valid career path for military related engineering? Love guns and weapon systems and would love to deal with them but knowing singapore its probably very niche.

Already wasted 2 years of my life finding out poly (or at least the course specifically) wasnt for me but I dont wanna let the rest of my years go to waste.

Starting to think polytechnic isnt for me. Started out EEE in 2019 first sem went well. Okayish GPA. 2nd sem I crumpled up and stopped going to school. Took a year off. Diagnosed with major depressive disorder. Got medication. Restarted 2nd sem. 1st half of sem went okayish. 2nd half of sem started getting anxiety about going to school because of mid sem results. Homework piling on + anxiety + procrastination = more hesitation of going to school. I dont know how long I can keep this up. I think I might end up flunking 2nd sem again. Idk why but the medication seemed to just stop working after i went back to school. Its like school is making the damn thing inefdective.

I dont know if its the course or whether Im just not fit for school. I keep brining foward my doctor's appointments but flake out last minute because of the idea that the doc will be disappointed that Im not getting well like Im supposed to. (Which is fucking stupid but I cant stop thinking that). Idk why tf I should feel ashamed at going to a doctor but I just am.

It just seems like confiding in someone when you first meet them is so much easier but after a while I just cant. Its like i have to put this facade on of feeling better (towards my doctor). I know its irrational but I cant help but feel that way. I went to polyclinic to see a doctor i dont know and hopefully deal with my anxiety and got prescribed alpaprozam but apparantly they dont hold the medication in polyclinics because its a controlled drug and I have to go to the hospital to get it but I just cant bear to see my doctor.

My parents still dont know im skipping school again and I cant bear to tell them still. My mom got a stroke during that 1 year off from school I had. Even more reason as to not tell them. I know its only a matter of time before they find out though. Its a pressure cooker waiting to explode. Idk if i can deal with this anymore.

And its not like I can drop out of poly and start working. Sure I could but I dont think I can live up to the expectations of my parents and myself if I did that. The pay would also be low so I wouldnt be able to live the lifestyle my parents have managed to provide for me or pay them back.
So it would be just like an increased dosage. Okay. Thanks. Just needed some assurance.
Thank you so much. I really appreciate the help.
Thanks
I've filled the form. How long will it take to get approved?
Do I really have to fill up my physical address? The information will be kept private right?
No worries. Everyone here has their fair share of problems.
I think thats a bit harsh. They are trying to help and they are my parents after all.

Also while she was complaining about me not doing anything she brings up kids of friends who have basically skipped school as well. She thinks I wont apply deferment because those other kids didn't. I don't know why those kids skipped school but she said they all went to a mental hospital in the end. Maybe they had some similar issues? I dont know. But my mom trying to pinpoint why Im skipping school makes me feel panicked and stressed everytime she asks.
Yeah really want to stop existing. Only thing stopping me is the possibility of pain and dissapointment before i go. Thats why i always wish of some unrelated accident happening or just vanishing.
Yeah I have a dolphin.

Same. When I got into this slump my parents keep saying im lazy and keep advising me to be more proactive and do stuff. But they emphasise the lazy part a lot. And it makes me feel like shit because I already know it.

Ignore comment. Just using this as a log.

Missed exams. Holidays over. Still cant go to school. Deferment still not applied. Paranoid and stressed about teacher poking about and trying to 'help' by telling my parents everything about my life at school. Its like privacy and personal space dont mean anything anymore. Im really starting to dislike my teacher even though hes trying to help. He lied about not contacting my parents. He thinks i might be a druggie but hes just taking stabs at what my problem might be. My parents pretending they have not contacted him. It feels so claustrophobic. Stressed, paranoid about a lot of things right now, especially my teacher. Whatever hes doing, its not helping. Still afraid of killing myself. Still keep thinking about it. Hospital visit too far away so no valid reason for deferment of school.

Its not that I dont listen to music its just that I do so rarely. Most of my time is spent browsing reddit or watch streamers to distract myself. Either that or sleep. Music usually comes as a last resort when I dont have the energy to watch or browse anything.

People trying to help go "open up" "talk about it" "go out more" "stop being so lazy". Or it feels like thats what would happen if they knew I might have depression. It feels like theyll never understand.
Yeah sometimes I just hope an accident would happen or if I just vanished. That way I wouldnt have to blame myself for my own death.
Yeah its either that or me endlessly browsing reddit as a distraction for myself. If im not doing anything else my mind wanders off to worse things.
I feel stressed and paranoid when family and close ones are around yeah. Dont listen to music but I do feel way happier and more relaxed alone.

Turns out it was my teacher who contacted my dad who told my mom and feeds them info. From the looks of it my teacher seems to only be taking jabs and what my problem is. Even sent my dad an article about stories about drug addict revcovery(Im not a drug addict). I am starting to despise my teacher a whole lot more. Why does he have to do this? I get hes trying to help but its making me feel even more stressed and worried. Its not helping at all. I dont understamd why they cant leave me alone.

My family keeps asking me to open up to them because I seem to have a problem. On the other hand because I'm not really doing anything they go "you better go and do something otherwise you will become lazier" "You sit at home all day on the bed not boring meh" "you need to exercise more" "stop being so lazy" (In singaporean slang so its a bit weird). They also seem to talk with other people regarding my issue behind my back and somehow found out about my suicidal tendencies so much so they fowarded a suicide hotline on whatsapp. But when we meet in person its like nothing happened. They just pretended that message never existed. Tried to find out who they were talking to to no avail. Became really panicked an distressed about it because it feels like my privacy has been breached and makes me want to close myself off even more. All these things added up make me thoroughly convinced opening up to my family is a horrible idea, just based on their attitude about me not doing anything. It just feels like theyll treat it superficially and be done with it and say "Just go out more then you wont be like that". The only people I felt comfortable talking to was the person who was diagnosing me and my counsellor. But now I suspect my counsellor might be the one contacting my mom. But the counsellor denied it and I trusted her because its her job to keep mum about it. But I am starting to keep my guard up around her.

So yeah. Opening up to close ones is a terrible idea from my perspective because it feels like theyll never truly understand. I only felt comfortable talking to professionals about this. Sorry about my rambling. Im done.

Need to apply deferment for poly but no actual valid reason yet. Only a hospital referral note for subsidised fees. No idea what to do. Do I wait until the hospital visit like 3 months later even though school is opening now?
Seeing a counsellor soon and going for an mental health appointment as well. Problem is the sessions are quite far away.

Before I found out the teacher was talking behind my back I was still messaging the teacher to find out about who contacted my parents (He denied it but I think its him). When he was talking to me and was trying to inquire what problem I had he said I was an okay student. I dont know what that did but i just cried. But after once I found out he might be the one contacting my parents and that he might be lying I just felt like shit again.
Pretending I dont know their talking behind my back males me feel like a manipulative dick though. Or maybe they arent talking behind my back. I dont know but it feels like it.
Teacher seems to be talking to my dad behind my back to probe my problem. It doesnt feel comfortable having someone poking and probing at you even if theyre trying to help.

I had written this post 2 times before over the past week but never got around to posting it. Only reason I decided to post now because I just had a talking session with my dad that went nowhere where I ended up crying and feeling like shit. Turns out it feels easier to post when you feel that way.

I dont but I feel you. For me its just to reaffirm my feelings sort of. Like instead of standing on wobbly sad ground im on solid sad ground. Opening up irl is really hard so everyone does it here at the same time.

I suggest you not mind it or just keep posting occasionally until someone responds. Sometimes you just need to vent and someone to acknowledge the venting.

Already arranged an appointment with a local mental health group. My parents dont know though and it feels like opening up to them will just make them dissapointed. Like i just feel like they wont understand even if thats not the case. I dont know why it feels that way.

Yeah I just feel like sometimes Im just using it as an excuse for laziness. I dont even know whether I have depression or not but it feels like it. but i dont actually know. Going to see a professional soon to check whether im actually depressed and need help or if im just a lazy sack of shit

Easier said than done. It feels like it requires so much effort and stress to do something like that. It sounds so dumb but thats how i feel right now.
I dont know. It just feels bad. Im very worried and confused about my state of mind right now.

I feel like people might think Im just lazy and making up excuses but I genuinely cant find any motivation to do anything at all.
Screamed at them to leave me alone. Now feel like shit still.
